31 liveries. ✓ = on, – = off, empty = not set (Fenix default). Column names without the `fnx_` prefix. Meaning of the options: [Fenix Livery Configuration Options](https://support.fenixsim.com/hc/en-us/articles/12466593239567-Livery-Configuration-Options)
